_meta.description: Nepali country-name overlay, keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Empty object = fall back to English names from world-atlas / World Bank. Generate once via Intl.DisplayNames and review Nepal-adjacent names by hand.
_meta.how_to_generate: Intl.DisplayNames('ne', { type: 'region' }).of(iso2) for each code in src/lib/mapData.ts, then save non-identical results here. Only entries present in this file override English.
_meta.source: CLDR via Intl.DisplayNames (runtime) — this file is the reviewed, pinned snapshot.
